name: Score Strips
description: Open a sheet-music PDF or scan, mark where each line of music is, and read it one enlarged line at a time, moving on with a key, a tap, or a page-turn pedal.
problem: Musicians with low vision need printed music much larger than a page allows, so they crop and paste each line by hand or buy an app that exists only for iPad, Android, or Windows; zooming a PDF means scrolling sideways and down mid-piece.
